texte:
For our next Live Experiment session, we welcome @donpac_50 , a Tunisian artist and multi-instrumentalist who has been involved in numerous live music projects over the past years. 

This time, he’ll be taking over the MPC for a special live performance, exploring rhythms, textures and spontaneous musical ideas.

While you’re around, take the opportunity to dig into our latest arrivals: a fresh selection of second-hand records and new releases, all available to listen to and purchase at Eddisco Records. 💿🎧

Come for the music, stay for the digging.

See you Thursday 18:00 🖤

texte:
@eddisco_records is a record shop and label in Tunis, centred around vinyl culture, musical discovery, and showcasing the work of Tunisian and regional artists through both its record store and label.

Earlier this year, we linked up with them to record at their new store, located within L’Écurie, a cultural space in downtown Tunis. The full sets are available on our YouTube channel.
Useful information about our new record shop location @lecurie.tn and open calls for artists,labels & vinyl collectors!
